item.title: Lin Yu-Shu (林育武)
item.description: Lin Yu-Shu (林育武) Lin Yu-Shu (林育武) is a Taiwanese-American Presbyterian leader serving as an 委員 (Executive Committee Member) of the NTPC 執委會 for 2025/26 (西北區代表).

item.title: Rev. Xie Xinguang (謝信光)
item.description: Rev. Xie Xinguang (謝信光) Rev. Xie Xinguang (謝信光) is a Taiwanese-American ordained minister serving as 書記 (Clerk) of the NTPC 執委會 for 2025/26 (西南區主席).

item.title: Dr. Yunching Yeh Davis (葉芸青)
item.description: Dr. Yunching Yeh Davis (葉芸青) Dr. Yunching Yeh Davis (葉芸青) is 主席 of the NTPC 執委會 for 2025/26 (西南區代表; ntpc-usa.org).

item.title: Zhang Ai-Hui (張愛惠)
item.description: Zhang Ai-Hui (張愛惠) Zhang Ai-Hui (張愛惠) is a Taiwanese-American Presbyterian leader serving as 會計 (Treasurer) of the NTPC 執委會 for 2025/26 (西南區).

item.title: NTPC USA (National Taiwanese Presbyterian Council, Presbyterian Church (U.S.A.))
item.description: NTPC USA (National Taiwanese Presbyterian Council, Presbyterian Church (U.S.A.)) Official website of the National Taiwanese Presbyterian Council (NTPC), the PC(USA) council of Taiwanese Presbyterian churches in the United States.

item.title: Chen Hui-Chen (陳慧貞)
item.description: Chen Hui-Chen (陳慧貞) Chen Hui-Chen (陳慧貞) is a Taiwanese-American Presbyterian leader serving as 副主席 (Vice-Chair) of the NTPC 執委會 for 2025/26 (中原區代表).
